artifacts.notes: The content-delivery route https://www.vatican.va/content/dam/wss/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_decl_19651207_dignitatis-humanae_lt.html returned a byte-identical 44177-byte response with this SHA-256 on 2026-07-23; the alias is not duplicated. The response contains the complete numbered Latin body, promulgation formula and date, a partial subscription block ending with Cardinal Callori di Vignale, and consolidated notes. It omits the remaining subscriptions and final attestations printed in the Acta. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-23 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.

edition.notes: A dated Vatican delivery state of the Latin Declaration. The registered response contains articles 1-15, the promulgation formula and date, a partial subscription block, and consolidated source notes; the complete Acta subscription and attestation apparatus remains a distinct witness.
edition.publication: Holy See Latin web presentation of Dignitatis humanae, retrieved 2026-07-23
edition.title: Dignitatis humanae — Vatican Latin web state

work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Declaration on Religious Freedom, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 7 December 1965. It comprises numbered articles 1-15; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
work.title: Dignitatis humanae
